name: Build to-do sync
author: Brett
description: Every build gets a short name and a category (Plugin, Plugin extension, Add-on, Framework, App, Feature, Module), prompted when the build is made and shown everywhere, and a to-do list in the AmberX to-do manager (Builds › <Category> › <name>) whose items are exactly the orchestrator's steps, in order, with model, estimate and a link back. Steps tick off live as the orchestrator finishes them (store events, no polling); renames, re-splits, reorders, holds and blocks mirror; a finished build moves to Done, a cancelled one to Archive. The builds store is the source of truth (build-todo-sync@1): ticking an item in the to-do manager is owner-only and asks you before it changes the step. Idempotent, conflict-safe reconciliation every few minutes, a Systems-check row with Auto fix when the lists drift. Off = builds keep working and the lists stop syncing, with a note on the Builds list saying so. REST /api/plugins/build-todo-sync, MCP build_todo_sync_*, CLI axf build-todo-sync <command>.
